description:
KVK detail

Returns name, address and active status for a KVK number from our
company data. Local cache (48 hours) serves repeated requests.
`lastFetchedAt` shows when the data was last retrieved.

Cost: 1 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: kvk.detail
